interference_allocation: Even onset/release pairs, each credit <= condition prefix credit; last pair may use fractional support. Require (event_count+1)*spacing <= delay.
prefix_protocol: Begin with empty trace heads. Condition on N prescribed own outcomes assigned to one reference, with known uniform observed time support wholly inside the declared bin(s).

Age through the independently chosen delay and total actually assigned competing-reference credit. Then prescribe M own outcomes at a distinct timing bin (overflow for nonperiodic), using that reference family repeat interval. The first B outcome follows A after the registered delay; the probe follows the Mth B outcome.

Train the nonperiodic and periodic references in separate successive prefixes. Later other-reference outcomes multiply the completed earlier trace uniformly, preserving its conditional bin distribution.
Each targeted onset has a same-reference release counterpart, or a targeted release has a same-reference priming onset. Counterparts do not add to the targeted head or its competing-reference credit.
Score one subsequently issued physical probe only. Its frozen inventory weights are independent of its timing; its eventual credit still uses observed support, never mixture responsibilities.
Split the independent probe repetitions equally across onset/release target heads. They are separate fixed-policy runs, not two independent observations of one physical event.

Use M=1/4/16 independently of N, delay and interference. Each prefix resets the known every-fifth missing-exposure counter; after missing B exposure time still passes. The final B exposure is supported for all registered M. Same-reference counterpart heads remain actual separate events.

Additional cells set A outcome observed fraction and total supported-anchor fraction to1, retaining1/2 anchor modes, timestamp uncertainty, periodic/nonperiodic geometry, skipped outcomes and counterpart heads. This modifies only actual A credit; it is not a fitted weight or a fabricated confirmation. The B prefix and probe retain their original nuisance mechanisms.

planning.selection: Smallest allocation meeting every condition/truth expected Fisher SE, before random responses. No Monte Carlo if none qualifies.

fit.objective: mean categorical physical-record negative log likelihood, including missing detection
fit.failed: no converged finite interior optimum; failed fits remain infinite errors

nonsmooth_fallback.reason: Version 1 retains 73 failed fits and fails one condition point. Its best failed diagnostic estimates are near truth but stop before the declared smooth gradient criterion; the hard per-bin cap makes the likelihood nonsmooth.
nonsmooth_fallback.base_fit: Keep the three registered bounded L-BFGS-B starts and all successful smooth interior candidates.
nonsmooth_fallback.fallback_trigger: Only if no smooth candidate passes the original convergence, finite, interior and gradient checks.

fallback.start: Lowest finite loss among the three bounded L-BFGS-B results

nonsmooth_fallback.acceptance: Converged finite interior fallback, plus no lower mean NLL by more than 1e-10 over the 26 directions in {-1,0,1}^3 excluding zero at log-parameter step sizes 1e-4 and 1e-5. This is a declared finite local check, not a proof of a global optimum.
nonsmooth_fallback.scope: Apply prospectively to the version-2 allocation and a full new 100-dataset-per-point simulation. Do not relabel version-1 failed fits.

acceptance.scope: Every positive parameter, truth and nuisance condition; no pooled substitute.
acceptance.quantile_method: Linear interpolation of ordered errors; a positively weighted infinite endpoint yields infinity.

scope_limits: Conditional simulator and engineered reference inputs; no waveform-derived matcher validation.
Actual body/opportunity feasibility, full rendering/delivery and real execution fits remain required.
The known timestamp intervals need not share a global hop origin in this engineering assay; actual acquisition-aligned replay remains required before empirical fitting.
Prefix interventions, detectors and baseline are fixed engineering choices, not fitted human cognition or a production action policy.

A positive v8 result would depend on the additional fully supported prefix stratum. It would not establish recovery from only weak exposures or relabel the failed v7 study. Actual waveforms/body/reference matching must realize that stratum before adopting empirical collection.
allocation_cost_status: Numerical candidate only. Large replay duration is not accepted as an empirical collection plan; prefix reuse/checkpointing or a more efficient registered allocation needs its own feasibility evidence.

exposure_revision.reason: v7 weak A exposure has an unsaturated mass ceiling near cap6 under tau2. Add explicit fully observed/fully covered A prefixes to increase informative support while preserving all420 original nuisance cells. No true cap/bound/tolerance is changed.

fully_supported_first_prefix.missing_exposures: retain the same every-fifth missing-outcome rule; only confirmed A outcomes receive full support
fully_supported_first_prefix.remaining: B prefix, competing interference, probe anchor ambiguity and missing detection remain the original nuisance condition
